effect: The braces have become usable steel lengths and sheet, which may reinforce the support.

reason: The steel looks like the available material for stabilizing the damaged landing support.
expectation: The steel should reinforce the damaged support, possibly using the service tool.

effect: The steel formed a load-bearing crib, stabilizing the support and completing the chapter’s goals.
reaction: The wide base and inspection of the intact upper structure made the repair feel grounded.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the crib was most worthwhile: the result explained how the steel supported the load and why a permanent replacement could wait.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the braces directly on the support was the least worthwhile action, though the feedback identified the needed preparation.

surprise.text: The service tool turned the shipping braces into steel lengths and sheet rather than simply preparing an intact brace.

arbitrary.text: The initial need to process the braces was not obvious, but cutting them free of their shipping joints gave it a clear purpose afterward.

continue.text: Yes. The physically explained repairs and the prospect of discovering what comes next make another chapter appealing.
